title: Empty-Input Record Run
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic machine with $k$ Boolean work tapes and state set $Q$, let $T$ be a tag type, and let $S$ be the state type of a two-work-tape seeking machine. Choose a tag update function, the seeking machine, and its start and finish states; take an encoded input word $x$, a four-tape configuration $d$, a record-symbol word $w$, and record data whose state is nonempty and whose width flag is true. From the snapshot in the read-exit phase with both buffers equal to $w$, the assembled record-step machine reaches, after $2|w|+3$ steps, the snapshot in the apply phase with empty input data and empty buffers. Before the final step it reaches neither designated verdict state, and at every step through the run each work-tape head stays within distance $|w|+1$ of its corresponding position in $d$.
